surface: plate_delegate_to_agent, gh plate agents delegate, delegation packet contract
summary: Makes PLATE delegation packet-first by returning structured task, artifact, constraint, and retrieval-hint fields while rendering a shorter prompt from that packet.
migration_impact: Consumers of plate_delegate_to_agent can use the new packet fields instead of parsing the rendered prompt. The prompt itself is shorter and now points back to the canonical context map for extra discovery.
agent_notes: Treat task/artifacts/retrieval_hints/constraints as the primary delegation contract. Use the rendered prompt only for text-only handoff surfaces.
migration_guidance: 1. Prefer the structured delegation packet fields over parsing delegation_prompt.
2. If extra context is needed during delegated work, follow gh plate context show delegation rather than copying broad repository instructions.
3. Keep future delegation extensions additive so existing CLI and MCP consumers remain compatible.
